# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.0 Module 4, Russian Empire Early Modern Line (1600-1800, oe_rem_, slot 60). Generated by gen_rus_early_modern.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Independent rebel-guarded (fx17) fallback monthly pulse for Russian Empire Early Modern Line (1600-1800, slot 60).
# When scheduler slot 60 already ticked this month, oe_rem_ran_m equals oe_rem_m_now and this trigger evaluates false.
# Guarantees the Russian Early Modern line ticks smoothly even if BYZ/ROM has fallen or the human plays RUS/MOS/NOV/KIE.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_rem_fallback_pulse } }

oe_rem_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        is_rebel_country = no
        NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_done }
        OR = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_on current_year >= 1600 }
        trigger_if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_ran_m }
            NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_ran_m = oe_rem_m_now }
        }
        oe_rem_pulse_host_candidate = yes
    }
    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes } oe_rem_monthly = yes }
    }
}
